tasks.title: Scaffold Phase 3 Workspace Packages
tasks.context: Create the three new uv workspace packages first so later implementation tasks can work in disjoint package modules without competing over setup files.
acceptance_criteria: `packages/matching`, `packages/ats`, and `packages/job-parser` each have a `pyproject.toml` mirroring the document-parser workspace convention.
Each package has `src/<import_name>/__init__.py`, `src/<import_name>/py.typed`, `tests/__init__.py`, and a short README.
Package dependencies point inward only to `resume-kit-core` and `resume-kit-schemas`; do not add `resume-kit-ats` to matching until the job-match task explicitly chooses that dependency.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: haiku + low. Mirror `packages/document-parser/pyproject.toml`: hatchling build backend, package names `resume-kit-matching`, `resume-kit-ats`, `resume-kit-job-parser`, import names `resume_kit_matching`, `resume_kit_ats`, `resume_kit_job_parser`, Python >=3.12, workspace sources for core/schemas. Keep `__init__.py` minimal for now; the export task will wire public APIs after implementations exist.

uv run ruff check packages tests
uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser

tasks.title: Add Minimal Analysis Result Schemas
tasks.context: Add only the missing cross-package result models needed for explainable job match, resume selection, and version comparison so matching code can reuse canonical schemas instead of defining local duplicates.
acceptance_criteria: `resume_kit_schemas.analysis` exposes minimal new models for dimension-level match evidence, explainable job-match reports, ranked variant selections, and deterministic comparison deltas.
Existing `ATSScore`, `KeywordGapAnalysis`, `JobDescription`, and `AnalysisReport` remain backward compatible.
New models are exported from `resume_kit_schemas.__init__` and covered by schema tests for validation bounds/defaults.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: opus + high. Touch schemas once and serialize all schema work here. Prefer compact names such as `MatchDimensionScore`, `JobMatchReport`, `ResumeVariantScore`, `ResumeSelectionResult`, `ScoreDelta`, and `ResumeComparisonResult` only if `AnalysisReport` is insufficient. Do not add ATS or keyword-gap duplicates. These models are New, not upstream-derived, so no modified-source marker is required; note in tests that they compose existing ATS and keyword models.
verification_steps: uv run ruff check packages/schemas packages/schemas/tests
uv run ruff check packages tests && uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser && uv run pytest

tasks.title: Port Deterministic Keyword Matching
tasks.context: Implement the matching substrate from upstream refiner: whole-term keyword matching, keyword extraction from job keyword dictionaries, and gap analysis producing the existing `KeywordGapAnalysis` schema.
acceptance_criteria: `resume_kit_matching.keywords` provides deterministic whole-term matching, resume text flattening, `calculate_keyword_match`, and `analyze_keyword_gaps`.
Gap analysis returns `resume_kit_schemas.KeywordGapAnalysis` with missing, injectable, non-injectable, current match, and potential match fields.
Characterization tests lock upstream behavior for whole-term boundaries, empty keyword sets returning 0%, injectable split, and custom-section text extraction.
Source file carries the modified-source marker for `apps/backend/app/services/refiner.py` at SHA `116f9cc3b00e1ac91734a6c2679bf41ea64a0edc`.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: sonnet + medium. Port/adapt upstream `services/refiner.py:_keyword_in_text:38`, `_extract_jd_skill_keys:56`, `analyze_keyword_gaps:181`, `calculate_keyword_match:641`, and `_extract_all_text:682`. Invert `app.schemas.refinement` to `resume_kit_schemas.KeywordGapAnalysis`; accept `ResumeDocument | dict` and `JobDescription | dict` if that matches local style, but normalize through Pydantic/model dumps rather than ad hoc object inspection. Do not touch `references/attribution.md`; the compliance task appends the matching row centrally.
verification_steps: uv run ruff check packages tests && uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser && uv run pytest

Tests cover empty keywords, case-insensitive keyword presence, invalid resume payloads, and valid `ResumeDocument`/dict payloads.
Fabrication, personal-info, and section-preservation evaluators are not ported in this phase.

tasks.title: Adapt Deterministic ATS Engine
tasks.context: Implement the ATS package by adapting the deterministic upstream ATS seed into an engine that produces canonical `ATSScore`/`ATSSubScores` and adds narrow deterministic recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: `resume_kit_ats.engine` exposes `compute_ats_score` returning `resume_kit_schemas.ATSScore`.
Seed behavior is characterization-tested against upstream weights: keyword_match 0.55, skills_coverage 0.25, section_completeness 0.20.
Expanded deterministic checks add recommendation coverage for contact, section, date, and formatting risks without changing the seed composite contract unexpectedly.
No LLM, no network, no `app.*`, and no import from `resume_kit_matching`.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: sonnet + medium. Adapt `upstream/apps/backend/app/services/ats.py`: `_extract_all_text:33`, `_keyword_in_text:51`, `_compute_skills_coverage:64`, `_compute_section_completeness:98`, `_generate_recommendations:129`, `compute_ats_score:171`. Invert dict return into `ATSScore`; accept canonical `ResumeDocument` and `JobDescription` while preserving dict compatibility where useful. Add the modified-source marker with upstream path and SHA. Keep package dependencies to core/schemas only.

tasks.title: Build Provider-Injected Job Description Parser
tasks.context: Implement `job-parser` as the only LLM path in Phase 3: structured job keyword extraction through the core provider Protocol plus a deterministic raw-text fallback.
acceptance_criteria: `resume_kit_job_parser.parse` exposes a provider-injected parse/extract function that returns canonical `JobDescription`.
Structured path uses `StructuredCompletionProvider` and `StructuredCompletionRequest`; tests use `FakeStructuredCompletionProvider` only.
No-provider fallback returns a `JobDescription` with raw text and deterministically extractable title/company/keyword hints where feasible.
Malformed provider output produces a safe fallback or warning behavior without network calls or concrete provider imports.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: opus + medium. Adapt upstream `services/improver.py:604 extract_job_keywords` and `prompts/templates.py:188 EXTRACT_KEYWORDS_PROMPT`. Replace `app.llm.complete_json` with injected `resume_kit_core.providers.StructuredCompletionProvider`. Map upstream fields `company`, `role`, `required_skills`, `preferred_skills`, `experience_requirements`, `education_requirements`, `key_responsibilities`, `keywords`, `experience_years`, `seniority_level` into `JobDescription`, `Requirement`, and `RequirementKind`. Add modified-source markers to prompt/parser files. Attribution row is added by the compliance task.
verification_steps: uv run ruff check packages tests && uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser && uv run pytest

tasks.title: Implement Explainable Job-Match Scoring
tasks.context: Build the deterministic resume-vs-job analysis engine that composes keyword matching, requirement coverage, evidence placement, and ATS scores into a reusable explainable report.
acceptance_criteria: `resume_kit_matching.match` exposes `check_job_match(resume, job)` returning the new canonical job-match report schema.

Scoring dimensions include keyword coverage, required requirement coverage, preferred requirement coverage, evidence strength/placement, ATS contribution, confidence, missing evidence, and recommendations.
Tests prove keyword repetition alone does not increase score after first presence; support and placement drive additional credit.
`packages/matching/pyproject.toml` explicitly depends on `resume-kit-ats`, and dependency direction remains acyclic: matching -> ats, ats -> schemas/core only.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: opus + medium. This is New scoring logic plus adaptation of the upstream match-scoring concept (`services/refiner.py:641` and web-coupled `routers/resumes.py:462` rebuilt, not imported). Use `resume_kit_matching.keywords` for whole-term presence, `resume_kit_ats.engine.compute_ats_score` for ATS contribution, and existing `JobDescription`/`RequirementKind`. Keep all scoring deterministic and explainable; never count repeated keyword occurrences as repeated evidence. Add modified-source marker only if code is materially adapted from upstream; otherwise mark as original.
verification_steps: uv run mypy packages/matching packages/ats packages/schemas
uv run ruff check packages/matching packages/ats
uv run ruff check packages tests && uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser && uv run pytest

tasks.title: Implement Resume Selection and Version Comparison
tasks.context: Add the deterministic engines behind future `select-best-resume` and `compare-resume-versions` interfaces using the job-match and ATS primitives already in place.
acceptance_criteria: `select_best(resumes, job)` ranks multiple resume variants with stable tie-breaking and per-variant explanations.
`compare_versions(base, candidate, job)` returns score deltas across ATS, keyword, and job-match dimensions.
Tests cover ranking, ties, before/after improvements, regressions, and deterministic output ordering.
Implementation reuses canonical schema result types from `resume_kit_schemas`; no local duplicate Pydantic result schemas.
tasks.implementation_notes: Recommended Agent: opus + medium. Build new deterministic logic in matching. Use `check_job_match`, `compute_ats_score`, and keyword gap/match helpers rather than reimplementing scoring. Treat resume identifiers as caller-provided labels or stable list positions; do not add persistence ids. This task is not upstream-derived except for the concept of before/after comparison from `services/ats.py:171` + `services/refiner.py:641`; add source markers only where code is adapted.
verification_steps: uv run mypy packages/matching packages/ats packages/schemas
uv run ruff check packages tests && uv run mypy packages/core packages/schemas packages/document-parser packages/matching packages/ats packages/job-parser && uv run pytest
